text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position with repeated support for development","quality":"argumentative stance","description":"The essay states a definite position and consistently defends it rather than wavering or confusing the reader about its claim."},{"evidence":"addresses cost, safety, liability, stress, and entertainment","quality":"development of reasons","description":"The essay gives several distinct reasons and elaborates each one instead of relying on a single brief point."},{"evidence":"“if the technology fails and someone is injured, people wonder who is at fault”","quality":"use of source-based evidence","description":"The essay brings in relevant details from the article to support its claims, showing more connection to the prompt text."},{"evidence":"counterargument about disadvantages followed by rebuttal","quality":"argument balance","description":"The essay acknowledges objections and then responds to them, which makes the argument feel more complete and persuasive."},{"evidence":"introductory question, body paragraphs, and closing wrap-up","quality":"organizational structure","description":"The essay has a clearer essay shape with an introduction, middle support, and conclusion that help the argument progress logically."}]}
